title: Vocabulary book
description: English vocabulary with definitions and example translations in one user-selected language. Run validate_book.py for cross-record constraints and file-level checks.

phone.description: Verified IPA without outer slashes or brackets, or an empty string when unknown. Separate verified variants with semicolon and space. The Python validator checks wrappers on each variant.

wordHead.description: English word or intact phrase. Preserve meaningful spelling and case.

wordId.description: Continuous string IDs from 1 through N; array position is checked by the Python validator.

unit.description: Optional source Unit/Lesson name or path. Omit without grouping; empty string is accepted for compatibility.

tranCn.description: Definition in the selected language. Commas and semicolons in ASCII or full-width form expand into separate meanings.

pos.description: English POS abbreviation without a trailing period, or empty when unknown. No closed enum.

sentence_example.description: Exactly two nonempty LF-separated lines: English example and its faithful translation in the selected language.
